homonyms.basis: The census row carries no disambiguation field. No card is a homonym. 'Digital Labour Platform Tracker' (card 1, T's body), 'Global Policy Tracker on Digital Labour Platforms' (card 2), 'Policy Tracker on Digital Labour Platforms' (B3, B7) and 'Global Policy Tracker' (card 4) are names of the entity, all in the census's aka but the last. The distinct entities below are named by the field, the census or T beside the tracker and are never senses of its name.

the Decent Work in the Platform Economy Convention, 2026 (No. 193) (card 3; T's related initiative; not carried by the census record)
Generative AI and Jobs: A Refined Global Index of Occupational Exposure ('AI impact on jobs', B7; the census's neighbour ilo-genai-exposure-index)
Negotiating Tech: An Inventory of U.S. Union Contract Provisions for the Digital Age (the census's neighbour berkeley-negotiating-tech)

the ILO podcast episode 'Decent work in the platform economy: how a new global labour standard can help make it a reality' (podcast.ilo.org) and the YouTube video Cmv4lC7acPY of that title (24:01), candidates for card 5 whose identity with it is not established
the Karnataka Platform Based Gig Workers (Social Security and Welfare) Act, 2025 (a record of the tracker, cited by Wikipedia)

captures.q: ILO Digital Labour Platform Policy Tracker
captures.description: THE ILO DIGITAL LABOUR PLATFORM POLICY TRACKER, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'a global policy database that monitors how countries regulate platform work through legislation, collective bargaining agreements, and judicial decisions.' Coverage ('more than 30 countries'), eight issues, its audience, and two related initiatives: the Decent Work in the Platform Economy Convention, 2026 (No. 193) and the Observatory on AI and Work. Five cards, three of them the ILO's.
